inputBoundary: For one participant, a caller supplies a finite source-defined data-collection duration expressed in weeks and an integer count of emotion labels entered during the six-week study window.
outputBoundary: Exclude the participant when either supplied value is strictly below its source threshold; retain only when collection duration is at least six weeks and the six-week emotion-label count is at least fifty.
limitations: The source reports mandatory six-week collection but does not define whether weeks are calendar or elapsed units, duration precision, continuity, daily completeness, or missing-day tolerance; the caller must adjudicate the duration before this gate.

The source does not disclose label validity, duplicate handling, response identity, timestamp attribution, or how labels are counted at the study-window boundary; the caller must supply the source-window count.
The source's two duration exclusions and two label-count exclusions are descriptive cohort results, not expected outputs for an arbitrary fixture.
A missing input or nonfinite duration fails closed; this binding does not synthesize either value from the nominal study schedule.
Raw Android keyboard/session parsing, No Response removal, participant linkage, affective-profile construction, and statistical-result reproduction are outside this cohort-gate boundary.

No released source dataset, analysis code, or machine-readable source oracle was found; this fixture proves the disclosed threshold logic against the reusable component, not end-to-end numerical reproduction.
